actions.description: Measure a DC or RMS voltage on a declared channel or terminal pair and return the value with its sampling timestamp and measurement range.

inputs.description: Channel to read: the clone creates only the voltage_dc voltage channel
inputs.name: channel

inputs.description: Measurement range to set before the sample (SENS:VOLT:DC:RANG); omit it to keep the range the instrument has
inputs.name: range_v

inputs.description: DC measurement; the clone defines only the VOLT:DC function, so false is refused rather than measured
inputs.name: dc

actions.name: measure_voltage

actions.description: Measure current on a declared channel and return the value with its timestamp and range.

inputs.description: Channel to read: the clone creates only the current_dc current channel
inputs.name: channel

inputs.description: Measurement range to set before the sample (SENS:CURR:DC:RANG); omit it to keep the range the instrument has
inputs.name: range_a

actions.name: measure_current

actions.description: Measure resistance or impedance on a declared channel and return the value with its timestamp and excitation method.

inputs.description: Channel to read: the clone creates only the resistance channel
inputs.name: channel

inputs.description: Four-wire measurement; the clone defines only the two-wire RES function, so true is refused rather than measured
inputs.name: four_wire

actions.name: measure_resistance

adjusts.description: Measurement range of the voltage_dc channel (SENS:VOLT:DC:RANG)
adjusts.name: voltage_range

facts.text: Keithley2000Multimeter is a PyVisaInstrument opened at a VISA address
The multimeter creates three channels in this order: voltage_dc, current_dc and resistance
The voltage channel selects the VOLT:DC sense function
The current channel selects the CURR:DC sense function
The resistance channel selects the RES sense function
A channel query writes TRIG:SIGN and reads the measurement with FETCH?
A channel query returns a list and appends the first FETCH? value for each sample
reset writes *RST and *CLS and then loads the defaults
A channel range property reads the range with a RANG? query of its sense function
The voltage range setter accepts 0 V to 1010 V
The current range setter accepts 0 A to 3.1 A
The resistance range setter accepts 0 Ohm to 120e6 Ohm

measures.description: Identity string returned by the *IDN? query
measures.name: identification

measures.description: DC voltage measured on the voltage_dc channel
measures.name: voltage_dc

measures.description: DC current measured on the current_dc channel
measures.name: current_dc

measures.description: Resistance measured on the resistance channel
measures.name: resistance
